reviews.title: Pay to EXPORT?!
reviews.text:
Another app that forces a subscription onto its user for the most basic features. 

I do not recommend Clay, you must PAY A SUBSCRIPTION TO EXPORT! Not just to export in a high quality (they charge for that too) BUT just to export AT ALL. 

Absolute capitalist garbage.

reviews.title: WHY!!!!!!!😖
reviews.text: This app is probably a good one but you can’t even make one project without having to buy premium. 😡 Well you’d probably think that’s not that bad I can just take a screenshot well you can’t the creator programed the app to not let you take a screenshot unless you buy premium don’t get this app it is a waste of time. 😤

reviews.title: Misleading - Pay for Every template
reviews.text: They are misleading and wasting your time. They provide “free” options that someone can edit to try the app but then you can’t even use half of the options or save it without paying. Terrible tactic to trick you into getting a subscription you don’t need without trying the app.
